announcement.title: Cloud account safeguards and live Agents status
announcement.description:
Phone sessions reconnect after returning from the background, pairing keeps the correct computer connection, and private Codex sign-in avoids another account’s authentication lock. Concurrent agent approvals no longer hold up their own responses. Returning to Agents keeps your authorized list visible while it refreshes and clears it when your account changes.

Agents now show working, needs-input and idle states, with counts for the current filter. Explicitly linked workers contribute to their parent’s status; Idle means no current activity, not task completion. Cloud account deletion asks for explicit confirmation, records durable access revocation and waits for verified resource removal before reporting cleanup complete. Cloud recovery preserves revocations across restores, checkout returns have an account page, and mobile Cloud details are simpler. Existing onboarding, reorder, file transfers and the built-in browser remain.

Known issue: Hermes 0.22.2 can exceed its startup deadline on Intel Macs; that qualification remains unresolved. Windows installers remain unsigned.
